hooks.command: t=; if [ -n "$TOOLU_BIN" ]; then set -- "$TOOLU_BIN"; else set -- /opt/homebrew/bin/toolu /usr/local/bin/toolu /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/toolu "$HOME/.local/bin/toolu" "$(command -v toolu 2>/dev/null)"; fi; for c in "$@"; do if [ -n "$c" ] && [ -f "$c" ] && [ -x "$c" ]; then case $("$c" --hook-protocol 2>/dev/null </dev/null) in ''|*[!0-9]*) ;; *) t=$c; break;; esac; fi; done; if [ -n "$t" ]; then exec "$t" statusline hook session-start --event SessionStart --plugin-root "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; fi; printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"statusline plugin: no usable native toolu - checked TOOLU_BIN, /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin, ~/.local/bin and PATH. If TOOLU_BIN is set, it must point to a native toolu and is never replaced. Install toolu with: curl -fsSL https://get.toolu.sh/pkg/toolu/install | bash, or: brew install falconiere/tap/toolu. Then restart the session. See docs/install.md."}'; exit 0
